title: A Two-Way Street: Surveying the Interplay between Code-Mixing and Native Languages in Text and Speech
abstract: arXiv:2610.27631v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Systems for code-mixed (CM) text and speech rarely start from scratch. CM data is scarce, so most work borrows from the languages being mixed, which we call native languages. This transfer can also run in reverse, when CM data is used to improve models for the native languages. Existing surveys focus on processing CM itself, and none brings the two directions together. This paper fills that gap with a systematic survey of transfer in both directions, across text and speech. We organise the surveyed work in a taxonomy of transfer direction, route and modality. Through this taxonomy, we find that most transfer runs from native languages into the CM setting. The reverse direction is younger, and in it code-switching mainly helps by aligning the two languages. Text and speech work share methods but rarely cite each other. translated_title: 一条双向车道：文本与语音中语码混合与源语言相互作用的综述
translated_abstract: 语码混合（Code-Mixed, CM）的文本和语音系统很少从零开始构建。由于CM数据稀缺，大多数工作都会借鉴被混合的语言，我们将其称为源语言。这种迁移也可以反向进行，即利用CM数据来改进源语言的模型。现有的综述都聚焦于CM本身的处理，没有一个将这两个方向结合起来。本文通过一项系统性综述填补了这一空白，该综述涵盖了文本和语音领域的双向迁移。我们按照迁移方向、路径和模态的分类体系组织了所调研的工作。通过这一分类体系，我们发现大多数迁移是从源语言流向CM场景的。反向迁移的研究较为新兴，其中语码转换主要通过语言对齐来发挥作用。文本和语音领域的研究共享方法，但很少相互引用。在一个共享的语音基准测试中，源语言数据比新架构更有帮助。这些发现指向了尚未解决的开放挑战（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文首次系统综述了文本与语音领域中语码混合与源语言之间的双向迁移，提出按迁移方向、路径和模态分类的框架，发现迁移主要从源语言流向语码混合场景，且在语音任务中源语言数据比新架构更有帮助。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic survey of bidirectional transfer between code-mixing and native languages across text and speech, organized by a taxonomy of transfer direction, route, and modality, finding that most transfer flows from native languages into CM settings and that native data helps more than new architectures on speech benchmarks.
